name: io.github.saasontools/gemini-deep-research-mcp
description: Gemini Deep Research over MCP: async job handles (deep_research_start/status/reply/fetch/list/cancel plus a blocking wrapper) for 5-60 minute research runs, returning citation-backed markdown reports as local files with previews.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gemini API key (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey); GOOGLE_API_KEY is accepted as a fallback

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_DEEP_RESEARCH_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Default research depth: standard or max
